verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: צַ֤ו אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תֹּורַ֖ת הָעֹלָ֑ה הִ֣וא הָעֹלָ֡ה עַל֩ מֹוקְדָ֨ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ כָּל־הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר וְאֵ֥שׁ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ תּ֥וּקַד בֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: «أَوْصِ هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ قَائِلًا: هَذِهِ شَرِيعَةُ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ: هِيَ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةُ تَكُونُ عَلَى ٱلْمَوْقِدَةِ فَوْقَ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ كُلَّ ٱللَّيْلِ حَتَّى ٱلصَّبَاحِ، وَنَارُ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ تَتَّقِدُ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.en: Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is the law of the burnt-offering: it is that which goeth up on its firewood upon the altar all night unto the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning thereby.
verses.kjv: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This [is] the law of the burnt offering: It [is] the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
verses.web: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

verses.he: וְלָבַ֨שׁ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדֹּ֣ו בַ֗ד וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־בַד֮ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ עַל־בְּשָׂרֹו֒ וְהֵרִ֣ים אֶת־הַדֶּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֥ל הָאֵ֛שׁ אֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְשָׂמֹ֕ו אֵ֖צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَلْبَسُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ثَوْبَهُ مِنْ كَتَّانٍ، وَيَلْبَسُ سَرَاوِيلَ مِنْ كَتَّانٍ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، وَيَرْفَعُ ٱلرَّمَادَ ٱلَّذِي صَيَّرَتِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةَ إِيَّاهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَيَضَعُهُ بِجَانِبِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh; and he shall take up the ashes whereto the fire hath consumed the burnt-offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.web: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

verses.he: וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְלָבַ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְהֹוצִ֤יא אֶת־הַדֶּ֙שֶׁן֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה אֶל־מָקֹ֖ום טָהֹֽור׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَخْلَعُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَلْبَسُ ثِيَابًا أُخْرَى، وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلرَّمَادَ إِلَى خَارِجِ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ، إِلَى مَكَانٍ طَاهِرٍ.
verses.en: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.kjv: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.web: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

verses.he: וְהָאֵ֨שׁ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ תּֽוּקַד־בֹּו֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וּבִעֵ֨ר עָלֶ֧יהָ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עֵצִ֖ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָרַ֤ךְ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הָֽעֹלָ֔ה וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖יהָ חֶלְבֵ֥י הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَٱلنَّارُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ تَتَّقِدُ عَلَيْهِ. لَا تَطْفَأُ. وَيُشْعِلُ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ حَطَبًا كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ، وَيُرَتِّبُ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمُحْرَقَةَ، وَيُوقِدُ عَلَيْهَا شَحْمَ ذَبَائِحِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ.
verses.en: And the fire upon the altar shall be kept burning thereby, it shall not go out; and the priest shall kindle wood on it every morning; and he shall lay the burnt-offering in order upon it, and shall make smoke thereon the fat of the peace-offerings.
verses.kjv: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.web: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.he: אֵ֗שׁ תָּמִ֛יד תּוּקַ֥ד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לֹ֥א תִכְבֶֽה׃ ס
verses.ar: نَارٌ دَائِمَةٌ تَتَّقِدُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ. لَا تَطْفَأُ.
verses.en: Fire shall be kept burning upon the altar continually; it shall not go out.
verses.kjv: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.web: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

verses.he: וְזֹ֥את תֹּורַ֖ת הַמִּנְחָ֑ה הַקְרֵ֨ב אֹתָ֤הּ בְּנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֖י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.ar: «وَهَذِهِ شَرِيعَةُ ٱلتَّقْدِمَةِ: يُقَدِّمُهَا بَنُو هَارُونَ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَى قُدَّامِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ،
verses.en: And this is the law of the meal-offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, in front of the altar.
verses.kjv: ¶ And this [is] the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
verses.web: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

verses.he: וְהֵרִ֨ים מִמֶּ֜נּוּ בְּקֻמְצֹ֗ו מִסֹּ֤לֶת הַמִּנְחָה֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הַלְּבֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ רֵ֧יחַ נִיחֹ֛חַ אַזְכָּרָתָ֖הּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَيَأْخُذُ مِنْهَا بِقَبْضَتِهِ بَعْضَ دَقِيقِ ٱلتَّقْدِمَةِ وَزَيْتِهَا وَكُلَّ ٱللُّبَانِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلتَّقْدِمَةِ، وَيُوقِدُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ رَائِحَةَ سَرُورٍ تَذْكَارَهَا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And he shall take up therefrom his handful, of the fine flour of the meal-offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meal-offering, and shall make the memorial-part thereof smoke upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which [is] upon the meat offering, and shall burn [it] upon the altar [for] a sweet savour, [even] the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
verses.web: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְהַנֹּותֶ֣רֶת מִמֶּ֔נָּה יֹאכְל֖וּ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו מַצֹּ֤ות תֵּֽאָכֵל֙ בְּמָקֹ֣ום קָדֹ֔שׁ בַּחֲצַ֥ר אֹֽהֶל־מֹועֵ֖ד יֹאכְלֽוּהָ׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْبَاقِي مِنْهَا يَأْكُلُهُ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ. فَطِيرًا يُؤْكَلُ فِي مَكَانٍ مُقَدَّسٍ. فِي دَارِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ يَأْكُلُونَهُ.
verses.en: And that which is left thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat; it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place; in the court of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.
verses.kjv: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
verses.web: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: לֹ֤א תֵאָפֶה֙ חָמֵ֔ץ חֶלְקָ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֹתָ֖הּ מֵאִשָּׁ֑י קֹ֤דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים֙ הִ֔וא כַּחַטָּ֖את וְכָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: لَا يُخْبَزُ خَمِيرًا. قَدْ جَعَلْتُهُ نَصِيبَهُمْ مِنْ وَقَائِدِي. إِنَّهَا قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ كَذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ وَذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.en: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion of My offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as the sin-offering, and as the guilt-offering.
verses.kjv: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it [unto them for] their portion of my offerings made by fire; it [is] most holy, as [is] the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
verses.web: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

verses.he: כָּל־זָכָ֞ר בִּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ יֹֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה חָק־עֹולָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֥ע בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃ פ
verses.ar: كُلُّ ذَكَرٍ مِنْ بَنِي هَارُونَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا. فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ مِنْ وَقَائِدِ ٱلرَّبِّ. كُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّهَا يَتَقَدَّسُ».
verses.en: Every male among the children of Aaron may eat of it, as a due for ever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire; whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.kjv: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. [It shall be] a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.web: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: זֶ֡ה קָרְבַּן֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֣יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֗ה בְּיֹום֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹתֹ֔ו עֲשִׂירִ֨ת הָאֵפָ֥ה סֹ֛לֶת מִנְחָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מַחֲצִיתָ֣הּ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָ֖הּ בָּעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: «هَذَا قُرْبَانُ هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ ٱلَّذِي يُقَرِّبُونَهُ لِلرَّبِّ يَوْمَ مَسْحَتِهِ: عُشْرُ ٱلْإِيفَةِ مِنْ دَقِيقٍ تَقْدِمَةً دَائِمَةً، نِصْفُهَا صَبَاحًا، وَنِصْفُهَا مَسَاءً.
verses.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half thereof in the evening.
verses.kjv: This [is] the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
verses.web: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

verses.he: עַֽל־מַחֲבַ֗ת בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן תֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה מֻרְבֶּ֣כֶת תְּבִיאֶ֑נָּה תֻּפִינֵי֙ מִנְחַ֣ת פִּתִּ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: عَلَى صَاجٍ تُعْمَلُ بِزَيْتٍ، مَرْبُوكَةً تَأْتِي بِهَا. ثَرَائِدَ تَقْدِمَةٍ، فُتَاتًا تُقَرِّبُهَا رَائِحَةَ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: On a griddle it shall be made with oil; when it is soaked, thou shalt bring it in; in broken pieces shalt thou offer the meal-offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: In a pan it shall be made with oil; [and when it is] baken, thou shalt bring it in: [and] the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer [for] a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְהַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַמָּשִׁ֧יחַ תַּחְתָּ֛יו מִבָּנָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ חָק־עֹולָ֕ם לַיהוָ֖ה כָּלִ֥יל תָּקְטָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْمَمْسُوحُ عِوَضًا عَنْهُ مِنْ بَنِيهِ يَعْمَلُهَا فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً لِلرَّبِّ. تُوقَدُ بِكَمَالِهَا.
verses.en: And the anointed priest that shall be in his stead from among his sons shall offer it, it is a due for ever; it shall be wholly made to smoke unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: [it is] a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.web: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְכָל־מִנְחַ֥ת כֹּהֵ֛ן כָּלִ֥יל תִּהְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃ פ
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ تَقْدِمَةِ كَاهِنٍ تُحْرَقُ بِكَمَالِهَا. لَا تُؤْكَلُ».
verses.en: And every meal-offering of the priest shall be wholly made to smoke; it shall not be eaten.
verses.kjv: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.web: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תֹּורַ֖ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את בִּמְקֹ֡ום אֲשֶׁר֩ תִּשָּׁחֵ֨ט הָעֹלָ֜ה תִּשָּׁחֵ֤ט הַֽחַטָּאת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קֽ͏ָדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ قَائِلًا: هَذِهِ شَرِيعَةُ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ: فِي ٱلْمَكَانِ ٱلَّذِي تُذْبَحُ فِيهِ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةُ، تُذْبَحُ ذَبِيحَةُ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ. إِنَّهَا قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ.
verses.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the law of the sin-offering: in the place where the burnt-offering is killed shall the sin-offering be killed before the LORD; it is most holy.
verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This [is] the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it [is] most holy.
verses.web: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

verses.he: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַֽמְחַטֵּ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ יֹאכֲלֶ֑נָּה בְּמָקֹ֤ום קָדֹשׁ֙ תֵּֽאָכֵ֔ל בַּחֲצַ֖ר אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلَّذِي يَعْمَلُهَا لِلْخَطِيَّةِ يَأْكُلُهَا. فِي مَكَانٍ مُقَدَّسٍ تُؤْكَلُ فِي دَارِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it; in a holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֥ע בִּבְשָׂרָ֖הּ יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִזֶּ֤ה מִדָּמָהּ֙ עַל־הַבֶּ֔גֶד אֲשֶׁר֙ יִזֶּ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ תְּכַבֵּ֖ס בְּמָקֹ֥ום קָדֹֽשׁ׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّ لَحْمَهَا يَتَقَدَّسُ. وَإِذَا ٱنْتَثَرَ مِنْ دَمِهَا عَلَى ثَوْبٍ تَغْسِلُ مَا ٱنْتَثَرَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَكَانٍ مُقَدَّسٍ.
verses.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy; and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in a holy place.
verses.kjv: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.web: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

verses.he: וּכְלִי־חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּבֻשַּׁל־בֹּ֖ו יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְאִם־בִּכְלִ֤י נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ בֻּשָּׁ֔לָה וּמֹרַ֥ק וְשֻׁטַּ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا إِنَاءُ ٱلْخَزَفِ ٱلَّذِي تُطْبَخُ فِيهِ فَيُكْسَرُ. وَإِنْ طُبِخَتْ فِي إِنَاءِ نُحَاسٍ، يُجْلَى وَيُشْطَفُ بِمَاءٍ.
verses.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken; and if it be sodden in a brazen vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.kjv: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.web: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

verses.he: כָּל־זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכַ֣ל אֹתָ֑הּ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קֽ͏ָדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ ذَكَرٍ مِنَ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا. إِنَّهَا قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ.
verses.en: Every male among the priests may eat thereof; it is most holy.
verses.kjv: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it [is] most holy.
verses.web: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.

verses.he: וְכָל־חַטָּ֡את אֲשֶׁר֩ יוּבָ֨א מִדָּמָ֜הּ אֶל־אֹ֧הֶל מֹועֵ֛ד לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֣א תֵאָכֵ֑ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ פ
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ ذَبِيحَةِ خَطِيَّةٍ يُدْخَلُ مِنْ دَمِهَا إِلَى خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ فِي ٱلْقُدْسِ، لَا تُؤْكَلُ. تُحْرَقُ بِنَارٍ.
verses.en: And no sin-offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire.
verses.kjv: And no sin offering, whereof [any] of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile [withal] in the holy [place], shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.web: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.
